WidgetAccessKey.title: Widget Access Key
WidgetAccessKey.description: Authentication credentials granting partner websites access to the public Booking Self-service Widget API. The plaintext API key is shown to the partner once at creation; only its bcrypt hash is persisted. Used by WidgetApiController via Authorization: Bearer header to authenticate widget requests (services list, slot availability, appointment creation). Rate-limiting is enforced per business_id per REQ-WSW-009.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this widget key for tenant isolation and IDOR-safe scoping.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

businessId.description: Public partner business identifier used in widget embeds (e.g. ?businessId=salon-001). Unique per administration.
businessId.title: Business ID

apiKeyHash.description: bcrypt hash of the partner API key. Plaintext key is shown once at creation per REQ-WSW-009 and never persisted.
apiKeyHash.title: API Key Hash

apiKeyPrefix.description: First 8 characters of the plaintext key, stored for partner-facing display ('bk_live_xxxx...') and audit-log identification. Never sufficient to reconstruct the key.
apiKeyPrefix.title: API Key Prefix

rateLimit.description: Requests per minute permitted for this business_id. Defaults to 100 per REQ-WSW-001.
rateLimit.title: Rate Limit

allowedOrigins.description: Configured CORS origins for the partner website (e.g. https://salons.example.com). Wildcards are not accepted per the CORS policy in tasks.md.
allowedOrigins.title: Allowed Origins

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the key was created.
createdAt.title: Created At

rotatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent rotation. Old keys remain active for 7 days after rotation per REQ-WSW-009.
rotatedAt.title: Rotated At

revokedAt.description: Timestamp when the key was administratively revoked. After revocation the key cannot authenticate any request.
revokedAt.title: Revoked At

status.description: Key lifecycle status. 'active' authenticates; 'rotating' is the 7-day grace period for the predecessor of a freshly-rotated key; 'revoked' is terminal.
status.title: Status

active.label: Active
active.description: Key is current and authenticates partner requests.

rotating.label: Rotating
rotating.description: Key has been rotated; remains active for 7 days as a grace period.

revoked.label: Revoked
revoked.description: Key has been administratively revoked and can no longer authenticate.

rotate.label: Rotate
rotate.description: Start the 7-day grace period after a new key was generated.

revokeRotating.label: Revoke rotating key
revokeRotating.description: Revoke a key whose grace period has elapsed.

WidgetAccessKeyAuditEntry.title: Widget Access Key Audit Entry
WidgetAccessKeyAuditEntry.description: Audit trail entry for partner widget key lifecycle operations (created, rotated, revoked). Used by SECURITY/Compliance reviewers to reconstruct who did what when to partner credentials per REQ-WSW-009.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this audit entry.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

action.description: The lifecycle action that triggered the audit entry.
action.title: Action

actor.description: Nextcloud user id of the administrator that performed the action.
actor.title: Actor

occurredAt.description: Timestamp when the action took place.
occurredAt.title: Occurred At

notes.description: Optional administrator-provided note describing the action.
notes.title: Notes
